question: What is FandomVerse?
answer: FandomVerse is your all-in-one community hub celebrating 7 major universes: Anime, Gaming, Movies, TV Shows, K-Pop, Comics, and Manga! Discover characters, articles, trailers, events, merchandise, and media in one unified platform.

question: How do I use FandomVerse?
answer: Explore universes from the top menu, search using the Global Search bar, click cards to view detailed lore and backstories, save items to your Bookmarks (localStorage), add personal notes (sessionStorage), and add collectibles to your temporary Shopping Cart!

question: Tell me about Anime
answer: Our Anime universe features epic series like Crimson Blade Chronicles, Skybound Academy, and Hana no Yoru. Discover 5 original swordsmen and alchemists, soundtrack clips, trailers, and convention news.

question: Tell me about Gaming
answer: Dive into Ashen Kingdoms, Neon Harbor Cyber Speed, and Fortress Tactics. Browse cybernetic character profiles, speedrun events, collector figures, and gameplay trailer showcases.

question: Tell me about Movies
answer: Experience sci-fi blockbusters and neo-noir cinema like The Lighthouse Protocol and Midnight Reel. Explore director masterclasses, character dossiers, red-carpet premieres, and film trailers.

question: Tell me about TV Shows
answer: Follow slow-burn mystery dramas and period sagas like Harrow Point and Kingsbridge. Explore lead detective lore, watch party schedules, teaser trailers, and writer retrospectives.

question: Tell me about K-Pop
answer: Immerse yourself in world tours and chart-topping hits with Lunar Bloom! Explore idol leader profiles, official heart lightsticks, dance practice clips, and stadium concert tickets.

question: Tell me about Comics
answer: Enter the world of vigilante mysteries and magnetic super-beings like Ghostlight and Iron Meridian. View classic cover art, artist signings, enamel pins, and superhero profiles.

question: Tell me about Manga
answer: Explore serialized ink masterworks like Tidewalker and Inked Worlds. Meet ocean spirit apprentices, read mangaka studio interviews, and shop professional ink drawing sets.

question: What categories are available?
answer: We feature 7 foundational fandom universes: Anime, Gaming, Movies, TV Shows, K-Pop, Comics, and Manga. Each universe has dedicated characters, articles, media, and events.

question: Where can I read articles and lore?
answer: Check out our Articles section for in-depth essays, fight choreography analyses, creator room retrospectives, and storytelling deep-dives across all 7 universes.

question: Where are the character profiles?
answer: We have 35 original fictional characters (5 per universe) with backstories, roles, abilities, and popularity ratings! Click any card to open the detailed lore modal.

question: Where can I find fan events?
answer: Visit our Community Events calendar to discover 21 conventions, stadium concerts, esports speedrun invitationals, and film screening galas.

question: Where can I watch trailers?
answer: Watch official teasers, gameplay showcases, and anime reveals in high definition with status filters (Released, Coming Soon, In Production).

question: Where can I find videos and audio?
answer: Stream orchestral soundtracks, podcast interviews with showrunners, and video breakdowns in our Videos & Audio streaming vault.

question: How does merchandise shopping work?
answer: Browse official fan gear including poster sets, hoodies, figures, enamel pins, lightsticks, and manga ink sets. You can add items to your temporary browser cart!

question: How does the temporary cart work?
answer: Your cart is stored locally in your browser using localStorage. You can adjust quantities (+ / -), remove items, and see the calculated total. Note that checkout is simulated for this student project!

question: How do bookmarks work?
answer: Click 'Add Bookmark' on any character, article, trailer, or event modal to save it. Bookmarks persist across refreshes via localStorage and can be managed on the Bookmarks page.

question: How do personal notes work?
answer: You can add personal notes to any bookmarked item directly in the details modal or on the Bookmarks page. In accordance with project SRS requirements, notes are stored in sessionStorage for your active session.

question: How can I search for content?
answer: Use the Global Search bar in the navbar or visit search.html! You can search across titles, descriptions, categories, and tags, filter by universe and content type, and sort by A-Z, Newest, or Popularity.

question: Where is the Art & Visual Gallery?
answer: Visit our Gallery to browse high-definition key visuals, concept illustrations, stage shots, and comic covers with an interactive lightbox modal.

question: Where can I see upcoming releases?
answer: Check our Trailers and Category hubs to filter upcoming releases and coming-soon premieres across Anime, Games, Movies, and Shows.

question: How can I contact the FandomVerse team?
answer: Visit our Contact page to send feedback, suggest fandoms, or view our interactive Google Map and contact coordinates.

question: Do I need an account to browse?
answer: Browsing, searching, and bookmarking work freely without an account. You can also explore our student-friendly UI Login and Signup member portals.

question: I like anime! What do you recommend?
answer: For anime enthusiasts, we highly recommend checking out 'Crimson Blade Chronicles' featuring the wandering swordsman Ren Kazama, and the soaring aerial action of 'Skybound Academy'!

question: I like gaming! What do you recommend?
answer: For gamers, dive into 'Ashen Kingdoms' (open-world fantasy RPG) and check out the 'Neon Harbor Speedrun Invitational' and Vex-09 action figure!

question: I like movies! What do you recommend?
answer: Check out our sci-fi blockbuster 'The Lighthouse Protocol' and the atmospheric neo-noir 'Midnight Reel: Shadows of Sector 4'!

question: I like K-Pop! What do you recommend?
answer: You will love 'Lunar Bloom'! Check out their Moonrise MV teaser, stadium concert tour schedule, and the Bluetooth heart lightstick!

question: I like comics! What do you recommend?
answer: Check out 'Ghostlight: The Origin Story' and 'Iron Meridian', featuring magnetic energy powers and vintage hero covers!

question: I like manga! What do you recommend?
answer: Dive into 'Tidewalker' and its ocean mythology with apprentice Yuki Aizawa, or read our documentary essay on mangaka studio inking!
